independence: Each full condition/load/history_n/repeat cell has a distinct SHA-256-derived seed; paired only across methods.

measurement.baseline_regression: each of five legacy modes compared with byte-frozen v1 engine outside timing
measurement.denominator_importance: sum of importance of ALL input tasks, including unplaced/infeasible tasks
measurement.order: independently shuffled methods inside each timing round of each scenario
measurement.parameter_tuning: none; previously specified parameters remain fixed
measurement.runtime_scope: seven modes of shared planner; excludes history aggregation; not standalone optimized algorithms
measurement.warmup: one untimed invocation of each of seven methods on the first scenario

recency.legacy_modes: use raw integer successes/total and ignore weights
recency.selection: fixed before v2 outcomes; not tuned
recency.shared_inputs: all seven modes receive identical raw and weighted counts

seed_derivation: First 8 SHA-256 bytes, big endian, of master_seed|condition|load_target|history_n|repeat; tagged RNG streams.

simulator.change_rule: historical start >= as_of - change_age_days uses shifted peak; earlier starts use old peak
simulator.evaluation: independent interval fit, no cascading delay propagation
simulator.fresh_history: observed drift may contain completed post-change outcomes; no future outcomes used
simulator.future_random_numbers: one fixed difficulty and noise per task, shared by all methods
simulator.history_dates: uniform over 1 to 60 days before the first planning date
simulator.no_time_effect_control: no systematic time-of-day or category effect
simulator.unseen_drift: change occurs at as_of; all available history precedes the change

task_count_rule: Generate until sum(15*ceil(duration/15)) >= load_target*960; retain final whole task.
